question: How are Śiva-water and weapon-water defined and distinguished?
premises: The prepared mixture is designated as Śiva-water.
Weapon-water arises from chanting the weapon-mantra.
inference: Śiva-water is the designated mixture, while weapon-water is produced through recitation of the weapon-mantra.
plain_english: This is designated as Śiva-water, and weapon-water arises from the chanting of the weapon-mantra.
